user.title: Set up Yahoo Fantasy Football
user.description: Enter your league id, or paste the full address of your league page — the id is the number in the URL. A public league needs nothing else. A private league also needs your Yahoo cookie, copied from a browser where you are signed in to Yahoo; the README shows how. Leave the display name blank to use the league's own name.

data_description.cookie: Leave blank for a public league. The cookie signs in to your whole Yahoo account; it is stored in Home Assistant and sent only to Yahoo's fantasy league server.

team.title: Which team is yours?
team.description: Pick your team in {league} to get a sensor for your own matchup. Choose none for the league scoreboard only.

reauth_confirm.title: New Yahoo cookie needed
reauth_confirm.description: Yahoo no longer accepts the cookie for {league}. It expires, and signing out of Yahoo ends it. Copy it again from a browser where you are signed in to Yahoo, as the README shows.

error.invalid_league_id: No league id found. Enter the number from your league URL, or paste the whole address.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Yahoo, or that league id returned nothing. Check the id and try again.
error.yahoo_access_denied: Yahoo refused access to its league data (HTTP 401/403). Try again later. If the problem persists, report the error to the integration maintainer.
error.league_not_found: Yahoo has no league with that id this season, or the league is private. Check the number after /f1/ in your league's address. For a private league, also enter your Yahoo cookie.
error.cookie_rejected: Yahoo did not serve this league with that cookie. Check the league id, and copy the cookie again from a browser signed in to a Yahoo account in the league.
error.invalid_cookie: That does not look like a cookie. Paste the value of the Cookie request header, e.g. A1=…; A3=…; T=…; Y=…

abort.reauth_successful: The new cookie works. The league is reloading.
